sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and your kind words. We value our long cooperation with your family foundry and the care your team puts into every PH-100 housing.

We understand that labour costs have risen. We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2, sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3). We have a bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part (cost:part:PH-100).

We would like to give you more security with a longer partnership, and propose three packages:
- Option A: EUR 50.60 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 50.27 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01
- Option C: EUR 50.20 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your long-standing partnership and the thoroughness of your review.
While it is our strict policy not to share internal cost breakdowns, our pricing accurately reflects the necessary investments in quality and recent wage increases.
To provide you with the security you seek, we are willing to commit to a 24-month contract starting April 2027 with 30-day payment terms, and can offer a revised price of €51.40 per unit.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the care you took in checking our figures. We appreciate that you moved on the price and agreed to our payment terms. After our long partnership, that means a lot to us. We understand that your quality investments and wage increases matter, and we want your foundry to stay strong.

We have compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342).

We would like to take a step toward you and keep the package you answered. We see two options:

- Option A: EUR 50.72 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 50.37 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
